title: ahle haram me shor hai moula kahan chale
body:
ahle haram me shor hai moula kahan chale
aaqa kahan chale shahe waala kahan chale
chalees saal roke shahedee'n ki yaad me
beemare karbalae mo'alla kahan chale
<<DIVIDER>>
baaqar lipat ke laash se kehte hai baar baar
baba kahan chale mere baba kahan chale
aawaz aa rahi hai janaabe ameer ki
muztar hai roohe fatima zahra kahan chale
<<DIVIDER>>
qabre nabi larazti hai muztar hai ahle bait
sar peet'te hai ahle mohalla kahan chale
ummul banee'n ye puch rahi hai basad mehen
zainulleba bataao qudaara kahan chale
